caption: A refrigerator door is opened in a dark kitchen, and light from inside the fridge spills out across the floor.

sa.check: A refrigerator stands in a dark kitchen.
Light from inside spills out across the floor.
The light widens as the door opens.

pc.expect: The light appears as the door opens, widens with the door, and lights the floor in front of it.
pc.fail: Light spills with the door shut; or the floor stays dark with the door open; or the light is behind the fridge.

pc.expect: The lit area grows as the door swings wider and would shrink as it closes.
pc.fail: It shrinks as the door opens; or is full width before the door moves; or flickers.

pc.expect: The lit area moves only with the door.
pc.fail: It drifts with the door still; or appears before the door moves.

pc.expect: The lit area is a wedge on the floor spreading from the door.
pc.fail: It is a round spot; or it is on the ceiling only; or it splits.
A second door appears; or the fridge vanishes; or the light becomes solid.

pc.expect: The kitchen and the fridge stay the same.
pc.fail: The fridge changes colour; or the kitchen rearranges; or the light changes colour.

note: Illumination: the on/off causality of electric lights belongs to Electricity; here only where the light goes once it exists is judged.
